name: Toyoura (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Toyoura town emblem in green, red and navy: a red ring enclosing a stylised character within a broken ring of green and navy.
history: Municipal flag of Toyoura, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 July 1947.

features.role: Toyoura town emblem — a red ring enclosing a stylised character within a broken ring of green and navy
